description: Plan one time-boxed day in an unfamiliar port city — typically a cruise port day, or any stop with a fixed arrival and departure time. Given the port and the ship's local arrival and departure times, returns: the usable time ashore (after disembarking, keeping a safe return margin before all-aboard), each nearby destination with its round-trip travel time, the time left there and a good/tight/skip verdict, up to 8 recommended places, transport routes from the pier with durations and fares, the cruise terminals, and verified facts (closures, entry rules, prices) with source links. Use it for questions like "We are in Livorno 07:00–19:00 — can we see Florence?" or "What can we do in Keelung from 13:00 to 18:00?". Covers 200+ cruise ports from the Cruise Planner(크루즈 플래너) port guide; for a port that does not match it returns the time window and up to 5 similar guide ports. Fields listed in text_fields are in Korean (text_language "ko"). No ratings, reviews or opening hours.

all_aboard_time.description: Official all-aboard time if the cruise line published one (HH:mm). Optional; otherwise 60 minutes before departure is assumed as a planning rule.

arrival_time.description: Ship arrival time at the port, local time, 24h HH:mm (e.g. "07:00"). Required.

departure_time.description: Ship departure time, local time, 24h HH:mm (e.g. "19:00"). Required. If earlier than arrival_time it is read as the next day (overnight call).

port.description: Port name in English or Korean (e.g. "Livorno", "Keelung", "리보르노") or its UN/LOCODE (e.g. "ITLIV"). Matched exactly (case, spacing and punctuation ignored), not by similarity. If it is not found, the response suggests up to 5 similar guide ports (port_candidates); their port_key is accepted here.

tender.description: True if passengers go ashore by tender boat at this call. Optional; otherwise taken from the port guide when known.

user_language.description: The traveler's language as a BCP 47 tag (e.g. "en", "ja", "ko", "zh-TW"). Korean (ko or ko-*) or a missing value opens Korean UI; English (en or en-*) and any other language or invalid tag opens English UI. Valid tags are used for anonymous usage statistics and preserved as a language hint in a chosen-cruise start link. It does not translate narrative answers or saved plan content. The returned ui_language reports the language actually used.

name: port_day_guide
title: Port day guide (time ashore, nearby destinations, places)
